failed_completion.error: associated source memberships must partition native supports

proposed_repair.association_membership_plane: measurement-labels-fits for Hebog when present; otherwise publication labels
proposed_repair.change_order: select the association plane before constructing catalogue-source objects

required_tests: a Hebog fixture with deliberately different measurement and publication labels passes measurement labels to catalogue-source reconstruction
the same fixture continues passing publication labels to published-mask statistics
a reference finder without measurement labels uses publication labels for both roles
the strict native-support partition error remains covered
the exact preserved products and all evaluation identities pass a complete no-write preflight before any retry

root_cause.cause: The tail adapter called _candidate_objects with publication_labels before choosing association_labels. Hebog catalogue-source component counts describe measurement support, including bounded low-persistence components that are intentionally absent from publication labels. The strict membership partition validator therefore received the wrong plane and rejected it.
